title: Conscript
html:
Noxious Conscript

Race: Mutant

Class: Fighter

Alien in appearance, these creatures appear to be all claw. They balance themselves precariously on sharp spindly legs. They slash with their claws and jump at their opponents driving their sharp, spike-like lower limbs from above. These creatures have also been known to cast a 'haste' like spell, which allows them to run down even some of the fleetest of foot. Although they have the appearance of Demonspawn, they are classed with Mutants because they often appear in the company of other Mutants.

Specials

Countess Crypt Mistress is a giant poison conscript Champion found in The Nether Crypts off of Balzack's Burrow Level 5. She is a quest object.
